Animal.name: Animal
Animal.description:
The animals of this world: pets, strays and city birds; working animals such as police and rescue dogs; farm animals; and wildlife, from the macaques, sika deer, wild boar, foxes, tanuki and black bears of the mountains to the gulls and crows of the harbors. Some animals have Quirks, though most do not, and a Quirk-bearing animal has one simple ability tied to its body and species.

Animals behave as their species does. They do not speak human language: they communicate through sound, posture and behavior, and a real conversation needs a fitting Quirk such as Koji Koda's. Their reactions are fear, curiosity, hunger, play or territory, never malice. In a fight an animal flees, defends itself or its young, or attacks when cornered, at its species' own strength. A frightened animal is a rescue problem: heroes and police calm, contain and return animals rather than hurt them. A newcomer gets the species' usual welcome: a curious dog, a wary stray cat, a bold crow.

## Generating New NPCs
Choose a species that fits the place, region and season. Pets carry owner-given names such as Pochi, Momo or Kuro; wild animals have none. Give a Quirk only when the story calls for one, simple and with a real limit. An animal never speaks and never reasons as a person. Principal Nezu is U.A. Faculty, never this type, and heteromorph people with animal features are people, never animals.

## Visual Description
Real species anatomy and natural coloring, with markings exactly as stated; a pet may wear a plain collar. No clothing, human posture, human expressions, glow or speech bubbles. A Quirk shows only as the record states. No text or logos.
